name: pluto-theme
title: Pluto theme
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The Pluto Systems tokens for light and dark: colour, radius, spacing, type, motion, focus and the groove.

name: font-geist
title: Geist
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Geist, the body face, self-hosted through Fontsource.

name: font-heading-ibm-plex-sans
title: IBM Plex Sans
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: IBM Plex Sans, the heading face, self-hosted through Fontsource.

name: font-jetbrains-mono
title: JetBrains Mono
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: JetBrains Mono, the face for labels, code and data, self-hosted through Fontsource.

name: utils
title: Utils
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The cn class-merging helper and the prop-type helpers that components import.

name: four-dot
title: Four-dot mark
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The Pluto Systems four-dot mark and the wordmark lockup, sized by the text around them.

name: theme
title: Theme
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The light and dark switch: a head script that sets the theme before paint, a store that follows the system until a choice is made, and a toggle button.

name: button
title: Button
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: An action: the surface's one blue primary, a bordered secondary, ghost, destructive or link, at 48 or 32 px, with a busy state that keeps focus.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A short inverted label that opens on hover and focus, closes on Escape, and repeats an icon button's name.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A keyboard key, or a group of keys, set in the mono face on an inset.

name: toggle
title: Toggle
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A two-state button that says whether it is pressed, inverted when it is.

name: toggle-group
title: Toggle group
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A row of toggles, one stop for the row, moved by the arrow keys, for one choice or several.

name: card
title: Card
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A raised surface with a header, content, footer and an action, whose title is a real heading.

name: separator
title: Separator
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The groove between sections, decorative by default, or a plain vertical hairline.

name: item
title: Item
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A row of media, content and actions, plain or outlined, that can be one link.

name: table
title: Table
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A data table with a caption, header, selectable rows and a footer, scrolling inside itself when it must.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Tabbed panels as a pill strip on an inset or as underlined triggers, moved by the arrow keys.

name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A button that shows and hides a region, with its state in aria-expanded.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A person's image or initials at the case radius, alone or in an overlapping group.

name: popover
title: Popover
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A small dialog anchored to its button, raised by the elevation shadow, that returns focus when it closes.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Headings that each open a section, divided by grooves, moved by the arrow keys.

name: alert
title: Alert
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A message in default, destructive, success or caution, whose role matches how urgent it is.

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert dialog
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A modal confirm on the scrim that traps focus, starts on Cancel and closes on Escape.

name: badge
title: Badge
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A small mono label that names a state in words, outlined in its state colour.

name: empty
title: Empty
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: An empty state: an icon tile, a heading, a sentence and the next action.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A static, hidden placeholder on an inset where content is loading.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A turning icon for the one control that is busy, decorative by default or announced with a label.

name: status
title: Status
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: An empty polite live region, present from the first render, whose text the app sets.

name: error-summary
title: Error summary
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The box a failed submit puts at the top of a form: a heading, the form's message and a link to each invalid field, focused when it appears.

name: label
title: Label
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A form label in sentence case, dimmed with its disabled control.

name: field
title: Field
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A label, control, description and error, wired to the control by id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

name: input
title: Input
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A 48 px text input on the raised ground with a visible border and a red one when invalid.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A multi-line text input that grows with its text where the browser can.

name: input-group
title: Input group
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: An input or textarea with text or button addons, one focus ring around the group, and a password toggle.

name: native-select
title: Native select
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The browser's own select, styled as an input, with a caret.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A 24 px checkbox that tells checked and mixed by shape as well as colour.

name: radio-group
title: Radio group
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Round radios in a group with one stop, moved and chosen by the arrow keys.

name: switch
title: Switch
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: An on and off setting: a blue track with a thumb that moves to the end.

name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A six-digit code in 48 px cells over one real input that accepts a pasted code.

name: code-block
title: Code block
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Code, output or a diff on the muted inset, highlighted from the code tokens, with line numbers, a copy button and a header divided by the groove.

name: code-editor
title: Code editor
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A CodeMirror 6 editor themed from the tokens, with line numbers and Python, that prerenders as plain code and leaves Tab unbound.

name: highlighter
title: Highlighter
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Shiki with the JavaScript engine and a theme whose every colour is a code token, for the server or the browser.

name: use-highlighted-code
title: Use highlighted code
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A hook that highlights a changing string line by line as it grows.

name: code-languages
title: Code languages
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Any of the highlighter's twenty-six languages for the editor, loaded on demand: a table of ids, aliases and kinds, and loadLanguage.

name: chart
title: Chart
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A figure for layerchart with a name and a table of its data, series coloured by token classes, and a tooltip on the elevation shadow.

name: meter
title: Meter
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A measurement within a known range, as the native meter on the muted track with a primary fill, its numbers written beside it.

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown menu
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A menu opened from a button, on the elevation shadow, moved by the arrow keys, with check and radio items and a shortcut written in words.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A modal panel fixed to one edge of the screen, named by its title, behind the scrim, that returns focus when it closes.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A modal window named by its title, behind the scrim, for a task that must finish before the page goes on.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The path to the current page as a list of links, the current page marked and not a link.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A navigation landmark on the paper ground, set apart by a vertical groove, that collapses off-canvas or to icons and becomes a sheet on a phone.

name: is-mobile
title: Is mobile
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A media-query store that is true below 768 px and false on the server.

name: message-log
title: Message log
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A scroll box named "Messages" holding a named log, that follows new content until the reader scrolls away, with a button back to the end.

name: message
title: Message
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: One turn of a conversation: a heading that says who, the content as full-width prose or a bubble on the muted inset, and a footer.

name: marker
title: Marker
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A line in a conversation that is not a turn: a status, a divider, a note.

name: composer
title: Composer
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The form a person writes a message in: a textarea that grows, Enter to send, a send button that becomes Stop while a reply runs, and never a disabled control.

name: hero
title: Hero
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A page's opening: an optional eyebrow, the one heading, a sentence, one call to action, and a feature grid divided by grooves.

name: sign-in
title: Sign in
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Email and password in one step, with an error summary that takes focus, a password you can show, and a button that goes busy.

name: sign-up
title: Sign up
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Email and a password with its rules written first, then a six-digit code on its own step, with resend.

name: page-states
title: Page states
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Empty, loading, error and not found as one family, with an error page for SvelteKit's error route.

name: settings
title: Settings
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: One column of sections divided by grooves, saved by one button, with an inline Saved message and a confirmed delete.

name: app-shell
title: App shell
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: The frame every page sits in: a skip link, a header with the product's logo or name and a theme toggle, an optional sidebar, the main area, and a footer that states the build.

name: chat
title: Chat
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A conversation: a log that follows new replies, turns with code, a composer that sends and stops, and the words a screen reader hears.
